name: comp-290

frames.best_why: The card is shown largest, so the title, explanation, Learn more button and close cross are all clear.

tagline: A small error card with a headline, an explanation and a Learn more button.
summary: A rounded notification card for a failed action. A red alert circle sits beside a bold headline and grey explanation, with a light action button below and an X in the corner.
appearance: A bordered card with a soft shadow holds a red circled exclamation, a bold short sentence, two muted lines of explanation, and a small light-filled Learn more button. A grey close cross sits at the top right.
behaviour: Hovering the Learn more button or the close cross shades them, but nothing else happens: the card has no dismiss or follow-up action wired up.
demo_content: Title "We couldn't complete your request!" with the line about an issue preventing the processing of the request.
use_when: An error needs a short explanation plus a route to more detail without blocking the page.
avoid_when: Nothing is wired: the close and action buttons are inert and the card cannot stack or reposition.
customise: The headline, explanation and button label are written into the file; width, padding and the red icon colour are fixed, and it takes no props.
weight_why: A card with a couple of buttons and no animation beyond hover fades.

a11y.note: The close button is named and both controls take focus, but neither does anything and the card has no live-region role.

issues: The close cross has no handler, so the card can never be dismissed.
The Learn more button has no click handler and leads nowhere.
polish_why: Calm, well-spaced card with a clear reading order; only the inert buttons let it down.

popup style message with a close x
something went wrong notice with details
toast card with title and explanation
notice that a task could not be completed
floating alert with a small action
